rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone’s voluntary agreement or permission.

example.english: You need my consent before you can take a photo.
example.traditional: 你要攞我同意先可以影張相。
example.jyutping: nei5 jiu3 lo2 ngo5 tung4 ji3 sin1 ho2 ji5 jing2 zoeng1 soeng2

rows.note: Use this for formal permission or authorization, especially in official or written contexts.

example.english: Without the estate management office's consent, you are not allowed to set up a stall here.
example.traditional: 未經屋苑管理處許可，唔准喺度擺檔。
example.jyutping: mei6 ging1 uk1 jyun2 gun2 lei5 cyu3 heoi2 ho2 m4 zeon2 hai2 dou6 baai2 dong2
